WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.category, cp.subcategory, p.category AS cat_then, p.subcategory AS sub_then, f.net_amount, f.quantity
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) qr FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.category, l.subcategory, l.cat_then, l.sub_then, count(*) lines, SUM(l.net_amount) sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) returned_net,
 ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) rate,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.refund_net > l.net_amount + 0.01) over_ref, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.qr > l.quantity) over_qty
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE l.category='Garden' OR l.cat_then='Garden'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
      AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, l.subcategory,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.subcategory ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
